title: Lane J0 — GitHub Platform Assumptions Verified for Developer Workspace Implementation

installation_token.scoping: Can be scoped to specific repositories and reduced permissions

http_git_clone.format: https://github.com/owner/repo.git (anonymous URL only — no token in command)
http_git_clone.auth_method: GIT_ASKPASS — one-shot askpass bridge transfers token via stdout to child Git process; token never in argv, process listings, or durable storage
http_git_clone.remote_sanitation: Remote URL set to anonymous HTTPS URL immediately after clone/fetch via git remote set-url

repository_permissions.metadata_implicit: All GitHub Apps receive metadata:read implicitly

token_secrecy_design.token_storage: In-memory only; never written to disk, logs, evidence, or projections
token_secrecy_design.git_auth_method: GIT_ASKPASS — one-shot temporary askpass script transfers token via stdout to child Git process; token never appears in argv, process listings (ps), or remote URLs. Askpass script created with 0o700 permissions in system temp directory and deleted in finally block immediately after subprocess completes.
token_secrecy_design.clone_token_sanitation: Remote URL set to anonymous HTTPS URL via git remote set-url immediately after clone. Synchronization follows the same GIT_ASKPASS path and sanitation.
token_secrecy_design.content_light_guarantee: All models use SHA256 hashes for identifiers; no raw tokens, keys, secrets, file contents, or prompts
token_secrecy_design.environment_scrubbing: Subprocess environment strips RIG_GITHUB_* vars and other GitHub token vars before git operations
token_secrecy_design.no_token_in_argv: Token never placed in subprocess command arguments. All git authentication routes through _run_git_with_token (GIT_ASKPASS bridge).

deferred_seams: Durable selection persistence (currently in-memory per session)
Real installation approval flow (currently reads env config only)
Repository analysis integration with digestion pipeline
Pages publication execution (preparation only in J0)
Portfolio site target wiring (modeled but not generated)
GitHub App webhook event handling (installation.created, installation.deleted)
